title: Bahama Mama | Exclusive 30A
meta_description: Luxury 6BR retreat in Dune Allen with private pool, putting green, 4 king suites, beach access, bikes, and steps to Stinky’s Fish Camp. Sleeps 17 guests.
description_expanded: Bahama Mama Features - New Listing! Enjoy being one of the first to enjoy this spacious and relaxing home, perfect for large families, girls trips, reunions, and people who LOVE puttering around - 2-minute bike ride and 1-minute LSV drive to Dune Allen Regional Beach Access. This accessible beach entrance with a ramp to the sand offers beach service, seasonal lifeguards, parking, bike racks, outdoor showers, and restrooms. - Pet friendly for up to 2 dogs, 60 pounds or less. Approval from Exclusive 30A and payment of a non-refundable pet fee required prior to arrival. Unauthorized pets will result in fines and possible eviction - Enjoy exploring 30A using the 6 Taxi Bikes and 6-seater LSV (golf cart) provided during your stay. Both are serviced regularly by La Dolce Vita, and they are ready to adventure when you are! Must sign a waiver for access to the bikes and LSV. - Fenced-in yard with Private Pool, Spa, and shade screen. Pool and spa are heated at the same temperature. Pool heating available for an additional fee for arrivals October - April - Four Hole Putting Green! Putters and golf balls provided. - Outdoor gas grill - Poolside loungers and outdoor dining with umbrella shade available - Driveway parking for 3 vehicles - Keyless entry so the main entrance is always secure - Private elevator which travels to all floors - FOUR furnished balconies, with partial Gulf views on the west facing balconies - 2nd Floor main Living Area with Smart TV - 2nd Floor Dining Area with seating for 8 plus breakfast bar seating for 5 - 2nd Floor Full Kitchen with Wolf oven and range plus drip coffee maker - 3rd floor Laundry Room with HE washer and dryer - 3-minute stroll to Stinky's Fish Camp and Bait Shack. These award-winning restaurants are a favorite with locals and visitors. Enjoy live music, morning happy hour, and more as this must visit location. You can even pick-up bait and tackle with your coffee at Stinky's Bait Shack. - Additional nearby restaurants include Shunk Gulley (Yelp Top 100 Restaurants for 2022), The Perfect Pig, and Vue on 30A - Lots of shopping options nearby including Publix and Walmart Supercenter plus boutique shopping at Gulf Place - 2 miles to Topsail Hill Preserve State Park. Enjoy miles of walking trails, guided nature tours, and more at one of the largest parks in the area. - At least one mid-stay clean is required for any reservation 10 days or longer and this cost is included in your reservation. Extra cleans can be scheduled for an additional fee - Concierge services available, including grocery delivery, additional bike rentals, catered beach bonfires, boat charters, and more Welcome to your dream getaway on 30A! This beautifully appointed Dune Allen home offers the perfect blend of luxury, comfort, and convenience-just a 2-minute bike ride or 1-minute LSV drive to the Dune Allen Regional Beach Access. This nearby access point makes beach days a breeze with its ramp to the sand, beach service, seasonal lifeguards, showers, restrooms, bike racks, and parking. Spend sunny days lounging by your private pool and spa or practicing your short game on the 4-hole putting green. The fenced-in yard also includes a gas grill, outdoor dining with umbrella shade, and poolside loungers-perfect for relaxation or family fun. The 2nd-floor main living area features a bright open layout with plush seating, a Smart TV, and direct access to a furnished balcony. The chef's kitchen is fully equipped with a Wolf oven and range, drip coffee maker, and breakfast bar seating for 5, plus a dining table for 8-ideal for family meals and gatherings. A powder room is also conveniently located on this floor. Whether you're splashing in the pool, grilling out after a beach day, or enjoying a Gulf-view sunset from the balcony, Bahama Mama is designed for making memories. ***Pets are welcome with prior approval by Exclusive 30A. Please request your pet’s stay at time of reservation. Payment of our non-refundable pet fee must be paid at time of approval.***

1st Floor King Suite 2 | Smart TV, reach-in closet and dresser storage, ensuite bath with combo shower/tub
1st Floor Guest Suite | sleeps up to 4 in two Queen beds, Smart TV, reach-in closet and dresser storage, ensuite bath with walk-in shower
2nd Floor King Suite 3 | Smart TV, walk-in closet and dresser storage, ensuite bath with walk-in shower
3rd Floor King Suite 4 | Private furnished balcony with partial Gulf view, TV, walk-in closet and dresser storage, ensuite bath with walk-in shower and tub
3rd Floor Bunk Suite | sleeps 5 in a Double over Double Bunk plus Twin Trundle, TV, reach-in closet and dresser storage, ensuite bath with walk-in shower
